metadata.title: Intel investors are banking on a comeback — and then some

content.text:
Intel investors are banking on a comeback — and then some
When is a good time for a company to raise equity? When its shares are expensive, according to financial lore. Intel, which said on Monday that it would issue at least $15bn of new stock, is following that rule to the letter. Its shares trade at nearly 55 times forecast earnings
